description: A gate sequencer that spells out text in Morse code, with separate jacks for the dots, the dashes and the two together

params.text: Runs the sequence in one position and holds it stopped in the other

inputs.text: The clock: each gate above 1V moves the message on by one element
A gate above 1V sends the message back to its beginning
A gate above 1V runs the sequence, alongside the switch

outputs.text: A gate for every dot in the message
A gate for every dash in the message
A gate for every element of the message, dots and dashes alike

notes: The module does nothing until there is text to send: double-click the display to type a message, or take one from the menu's Load random quote.
menu: Loop — repeats the message from the beginning instead of stopping at the end
Letter spacing — leaves the standard gap between letters rather than running them together
Word spacing — leaves the standard gap between words
Dah:Dit Ratio 2:1 — shortens the dashes to twice a dot rather than the usual three times
Morse Output: Trigger — makes the combined jack send a short trigger for each element rather than a gate the length of that element
Load random quote — fills the display with one of the built-in phrases
Save to slot — stores the current text in one of the module's memory slots
Load from slot — brings back the text stored in one of the memory slots
Delete all memory slots — empties every stored text

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
